## What this plugin does

Describe the use on the panel and the settings a person supplies.

Plugin id and version:

## Reach and credentials

List requested hosts, requests, secrets and why each is needed. Say "None" when
appropriate. Include requested refresh cadence and any tap behavior.

## Preview and reproduction

Include an accessible 448×368 preview and the command or fixtures to reproduce it.
State whether the output was also inspected at desk scale.

## Validation

Record exact results for the faces tests, typecheck, lint, format and discovery.
Describe meaningful behavioral tests and distinguish local rendering from browser,
server and physical-panel checks. Link CI when available.

## Limitations and attribution

State timezone/date conventions, freshness, API failure behavior and other known
limitations. Identify any third-party code or assets and their licences. Include
no credentials, private addresses or personal data.

## Reviewer record

Reviewer to record the reviewed head commit, findings, required changes and outcome
using [the review guide](https://github.com/cosmicsymmetry/deskmate/blob/main/docs/plugins/submitting.md#review-and-updates).
Merge and hosted release are separate actions.
